title: Berkeley Yoga Center
blurb: Berkeley Yoga Center is a yoga studio located upstairs in a historical building adjacent to Strawberry Creek Park in Berkeley, CA. It offers a wide variety of ongoing classes suited to beginners and seasoned practitioners. The studio emphasizes a traditional teacher-student relationship and a humble, home-grown yoga experience.
extraNote: Upstairs in the building at 2121 Bonar Street, Studio C; door code required, obtained from the teacher of the class.
